entities.summary: Eusebio de Calonje y Fenollet was a Spanish military officer and politician of the Moderate Party. He served as Minister of State, Minister of the Navy, senator, deputy of Zaragoza, Almería and Teruel provinces as well as the Captain General of Aragon, Navarre and Canary Islands.
